snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Fire Warrior (Classic) - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Check it out on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4280930/Warhammer_40000_Fire_Warrior_Classic/

Originally released in 2003, Warhammer 40,000: Fire Warrior brings fast-paced first-person combat to the Warhammer 40,000 universe from a unique T'au perspective.
